stale_href_attribute_pass.why: Link elements carried BOTH a Webflow link setting and a redundant custom HTML attribute named 'href'. Correcting the link setting left the custom attribute holding the old 404 URL, so each element carried two conflicting values.
stale_href_attribute_pass.method: Removed the redundant custom href attribute, leaving the corrected Webflow link setting as the single source of truth. Note: Webflow reserves 'href' and rejects set_attributes on it ('internal error occurred'); remove_attribute and set_link both work.
